g.text: Shared-magnet power depends on materials, recovery and end transfer

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #414d5a

g.text: Titanium-49 cycle · 1.6 MeV ions · future material and recovery assumptions · no engineered reactor demonstrated
Solid traces in A include a 0.2 MeV extraction allowance; the dashed trace and panel C add a 25 kT end barrier and its conversion equipment.
Default: 95% ion heating/direct conversion; 99.9% potential recovery each way; 50 MeV per side event; 30 K radiators; 100 MJ/kg embodied energy;
0.01% annual replacement. All traces include complete mass allowances. Recycling, extraction hardware, shielding and conductor life remain unvalidated.
